# GitHub Japanese Translator - Chrome Extension Project

## Project Overview
Chrome extension to translate GitHub pages to Japanese.

## Progress Tracking
- [x] copilot-instructions.md file created
- [x] Project structure scaffolded
- [x] Translation functionality implemented
- [x] Popup UI created
- [x] README.md created

## Project Structure
- manifest.json - Chrome extension configuration
- content.js - Content script for translation
- popup.html/popup.js - Extension popup interface
- translations.json - Translation dictionary
- icons/ - Extension icons
